resolution: The log named both stalls and both are fixed in 2e3e4ec02. (1) commitMany count=358 totalMs=841: every event append ran its own sqlite transaction (BEGIN IMMEDIATE + MAX(seq) + INSERT + COMMIT) and each item appends TWICE (world event + session marker) = 716 transactions per move. The store now has a batch() door — appends inside share ONE write transaction per touched domain DB (begun lazily, committed once); sessions.commitMany wraps its loop in it, so a 358-event move pays 2 commits instead of 716. Expect that 841ms line to drop to tens of ms. (2) visualBoxes ms=43 spamming 6x per commit: the standing-city renderer redid the wall-join signature pass over all 4871 pieces on every re-render, and one commit re-renders several times. The pass is now WeakMap-cached on the pieces array identity — computed once per actual world change, cache hits silent and free. game verify GREEN 72/72 including the data-store and sessions suites. Move a big building and re-read the console: one commitMany line (small), one visualBoxes line (not six).
